name: Velvet Blade
body:
A velvet blade is a spy and infiltrator, trained in moving in the social circles of the nobles and other elites. Whether this training comes from breeding and filial connections, or by being a hand-trained tool of a noble family, you use your charms and understanding of social graces to get in close to listen or to silence.

Class Features
Socialite (Ex)

At 1st level, a velvet blade focuses their studies on social infiltration and etiquette. The velvet blade gains Diplomacy and Knowledge (nobility) as class skills. Additionally, if the velvet blade fails a Diplomacy or Bluff check against an individual of noble standing, one of their vassals or servants, or an individual of some other elite status within a society, they may roll a Knowledge (nobility against the DC, if this Knowledge check succeeds, they may reattempt the Diplomacy or Bluff check. This reroll may only be done once per target per 24 hours. If the velvet blade has levels in any other class(es) that exceed their levels in this class, they take a penalty to the Knowledge (nobility) check for this ability equal to their levels in the other class(es). This ability replaces the get the job done gained at 1st level.

Know the Target (Ex)

At 4th level, the velvet blade may roll a Knowledge (nobility) check instead of a Knowledge (local) check to determine the abilities and weaknesses of a creature of noble or elite status. Additionally, they may roll Knowledge (nobility) checks to find secret doors, hidden treasure or traps within mansions, palaces, museums, or other high society locations. This ability replaces the slayer talent gained at 4th level.

Hidden Weapon (Ex)

At 6th level, the velvet blade gains a bonus to Sleight of Hand checks to hide weapons on their body equal to their class level. Additionally, they are considered to have the Quick Draw feat when retrieving these hidden weapons. If the velvet blade already has the Quick Draw feat, or subsequently gains the Quick Draw feat, they gain a bonus combat feat of their choice for which they meet the prerequisites. This ability replaces the slayer talent gained at 6th level.

Treacherous Blade (Ex)

At 7th level, the velvet blade gains Betrayer as a bonus feat without needing to meet the prerequisites. If the velvet blade has the Betrayer feat, they instead get a combat feat of their choice for which they meet the prerequisites. This ability replaces the bonus feat gained at 7th level.

Silent Dispatch (Ex)

At 10th level, the velvet blade excels at dispatching enemies quietly. They gain the silent dispatch vigilante talent without needing to meet the talent’s prerequisites. This ability replaces the slayer talent gained at 10th level.
